block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.role: Soundtrack playlist, loop points, and regional background music bindings.
what_it_enables: Seamless sample-accurate looping for ambient and combat soundtracks
Biome and provincial soundtrack mapping (Sacyra, Libira, Dreamscape, Abyssal Rift)
Cross-fade transitions between exploration and tactical combat states
Dynamic moral sway variations reflecting the conflict with Dark Lord Usuru
invariants: Zero dynamic heap allocations in audio cue routing (ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP)
Loop end samples must strictly exceed loop start samples
Authentic canon adherence: sole antagonist is The Dark Lord Usuru
